name: Monad Native Bridge (Wormhole NTT)
not_assessed: how many keys it takes to move it
the time anyone has to react
the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: The chain’s own officially blessed bridge, governed by a live-verified 13-of-19 Wormhole Guardian quorum - read directly from Monad’s own deployed Core Bridge contract, not assumed from generic docs.
narrative.detail: owner()/pauser() on the NTT Manager resolves to a small, non-upgradeable Wormhole governance relay that holds no independent power - it only forwards a call given a Guardian-signed message that clears quorum. getCurrentGuardianSetIndex()=7 and quorum(19)=13, both read live. No time delay: a valid quorum executes immediately.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
